what_i_changed: Added pre-execution validation of selected category packs against the injected evidence reader, and made absence fallback records use that reader's vocabulary.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: Unsupported packs now raise `UnavailableEvidence`/`ValueError` before any operational port call. File-read and evidence-reader failures create empty `ABSENT` evidence for every advertised injected-reader name, so category results remain absent.
